description: NaYCl₄ is Baddeleyite-derived structured and crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven Cl atoms. There are a spread of Na-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.73-3.23 Å. Y is bonded to seven Cl atoms to form edge-sharing YCl₇ pentagonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Y-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.58-2.79 Å. There are four inequivalent Cl sites. In the first Cl site, Cl is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to two equivalent Na and one Y atom. In the second Cl site, Cl is bonded to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Y atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ClNa₂Y₂ trigonal pyramids. In the third Cl site, Cl is bonded to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Y atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ClNa₂Y₂ tetrahedra. In the fourth Cl site, Cl is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na and two equivalent Y atoms.
